body_zh: 本次问卷调查共发放问卷600份，收回有效问卷542份，有效率约为百分之九十。受访者中男性和女性各271人，年龄多在25岁到40岁之间。调查员用三周时间完成了全部录入，原始表格存放在资料室的铁柜里。
body_en: This questionnaire survey handed out 600 questionnaires in total and got back 542 valid ones, a valid response rate of about ninety percent. Among the respondents there were 271 men and 271 women, mostly aged between 25 and 40. The surveyors took three weeks to finish entering all the data, and the original forms are kept in a metal cabinet in the archive room.

body_zh: 面包店的店员连续七天统计了早晨的客流，周一到周五平均每天来客86人，周六达到132人，周日为118人。七天合计680人，日均约97人。店员把这组数字贴在收银台旁边的墙上，方便店主安排备货。
body_en: A clerk at a bakery counted the morning customers for seven days in a row. From Monday to Friday an average of 86 customers came each day, Saturday reached 132, and Sunday had 118. The seven days added up to 680 people, about 97 per day. The clerk posted these figures on the wall beside the cash register, making it easier for the owner to plan the stock.

body_zh: 调查中心的资料室位于二楼走廊尽头，屋里摆着六排灰色铁柜，每个抽屉上都贴着年份标签。靠窗的长桌上放着两台计算器和一摞空白问卷，墙上挂着一张手绘柱状图，标出了各年龄段的人数，颜色由浅到深。
body_en: The archive room of the survey center is at the end of the corridor on the second floor, holding six rows of gray metal cabinets, with a year label on every drawer. On the long table by the window lie two calculators and a stack of blank questionnaires, and on the wall hangs a hand drawn bar chart marking the number of people in each age group, with colors running from light to dark.

body_zh: 这只抽样用的木箱约有半米高，外面刷着深绿色的漆，侧面开着一个圆形小口。箱子里装着一百个乒乓球，每个球上都印着从1到100的编号，摇动时会发出清脆的碰撞声。箱底垫着一层软布，用来减少磨损。
body_en: This wooden box used for sampling is about half a meter tall, painted dark green on the outside, with a small round opening on one side. It holds one hundred table tennis balls, each printed with a number from 1 to 100, and they make a crisp clinking sound when the box is shaken. A layer of soft cloth lines the bottom to reduce wear.

body_zh: 这次住户抽样从划分区域开始，调查组把全市住户按街道分成若干组，从每组随机抽出两个小区，再在小区里按门牌号每隔十户选取一户。问卷由调查员上门发放，一周后统一收回，录入表格后又核对了两遍。
body_en: This household sampling began with dividing up the area. The survey team split the households of the city into groups by street, drew two neighborhoods at random from each group, and then picked one household out of every ten by door number within each neighborhood. The questionnaires were delivered in person by surveyors, collected all together a week later, and checked twice after being entered into spreadsheets.

body_zh: 计算班级平均分的过程并不复杂。老师先把三十份试卷的分数逐一相加，得到总分2460分，接着用总分除以人数，得出平均分82分。随后他把高于平均分的人数单独数了一遍，共有17人，这个数字被记在成绩册的末页。
body_en: Working out the class average is not complicated. The teacher first adds up the scores on thirty exam papers one by one to get a total of 2460 points, then divides the total by the number of students to get an average of 82. After that he separately counts how many students scored above the average, 17 in all, and this figure is noted on the last page of the grade book.

body_zh: 三月里的一个赶集日，一支调查小组在乡镇集市上做抽样访问，原计划访问两百人，不料当天下起大雨，摊位提前收市，最后只访问到九十多人。组长决定下一个集日再来补做，那天天气晴朗，名额很快就凑齐了。
body_en: On a market day in March, a survey team was conducting sample interviews at a township market and had planned to interview two hundred people, but heavy rain fell that day, the stalls closed early, and in the end only ninety or so people were interviewed. The team leader decided to come back on the next market day to make up the rest, and that day the weather was clear and the quota was soon filled.

body_zh: 去年秋天，一家研究所整理居民用水数据时，发现某个小区的平均用水量约为其他小区的十倍。工作人员回到现场逐户核对，原来是录入时多打了一个零，改正以后，这个小区的数字回到了正常范围。
body_en: Last autumn, while sorting household water use data, a research institute found that the average water use of one neighborhood was about ten times that of the others. Staff went back to the site to check household by household, and it turned out that an extra zero had been typed during data entry, and after the correction the figure for that neighborhood returned to the normal range.

body_zh: 平均值容易受到极端数值的影响。一个小组有十个人，其中九人的通勤时间在二十分钟左右，另一人单程就花两个小时，全组的平均值便会被明显拉高。遇到这种情况，统计人员往往同时报告中位数，它更贴近多数人的实际情形。
body_en: An average is easily affected by extreme values. In a group of ten people, nine have commutes of about twenty minutes while the remaining one spends two hours each way, so the average for the whole group is pulled up noticeably. In such cases, statisticians often report the median as well, since it is closer to the actual situation of most people.

body_zh: 样本量越大，抽样误差通常越小，不过两者并不成简单的反比。样本从四百人增加到一千六百人，误差大约只缩小一半，原因在于误差与样本量的平方根成反比。正因如此，许多大型调查的样本停留在一两千人，继续扩大样本的收益相当有限。
body_en: The larger the sample, the smaller the sampling error usually is, but the two are not in a simple inverse proportion. When a sample grows from four hundred people to sixteen hundred, the error shrinks only by about half, because the error is inversely proportional to the square root of the sample size. For this reason, many large surveys keep their samples at one or two thousand people, since the gain from enlarging the sample further is quite limited.

body_zh: 一项观察记录了十二名夜班工人连续两周的作息，他们平均每天睡眠六小时左右，其中七人有下午小睡的习惯。小睡的七人在情绪量表上平均得分为7分，其余五人平均为5分，量表满分为10分。全部数据由班组长每天傍晚汇总。
body_en: An observation recorded the daily routines of twelve night shift workers over two weeks. They slept about six hours a day on average, and seven of them had a habit of napping in the afternoon. The seven who napped scored 7 on average on a mood scale, the other five averaged 5, and the scale had a maximum of 10. All the data were compiled by the shift leader every evening.

body_zh: 二十名大学生参加了一次计时心算测试，研究员全程监测他们的心率。测试开始前，平均心率为每分钟72次，进行到第五分钟时升到88次，结束后静坐十分钟，又回落到75次。多数人事后表示，最紧张的时刻出现在倒计时的最后一分钟。
body_en: Twenty university students took part in a timed mental arithmetic test, with researchers monitoring their heart rate throughout. Before the test began, the average heart rate was 72 beats per minute, it rose to 88 by the fifth minute, and after ten minutes of sitting quietly at the end it fell back to 75. Most of them said afterward that the tensest moment came in the final minute of the countdown.

body_zh: 办公楼三层的休息室面积不大，两张浅灰色沙发贴着墙并排，角落里是一台饮水机。几盆绿萝搁在窗台上，午后阳光照进来，屋里显得很安静，常有职员来这里闭眼坐上一刻钟，再回到工位。
body_en: The rest room on the third floor of the office building is not large, with two light gray sofas side by side against the wall and a water dispenser in the corner. A few pots of pothos rest on the windowsill, and when the afternoon sun shines in, the room feels very quiet, so staff often come here to sit with their eyes closed for a quarter of an hour before going back to their desks.

body_zh: 幼儿园教室门口挂着一块情绪记录板，上面画着五张表情不同的圆脸，从大笑到哭泣依次排开。每个孩子都有一枚印着小动物的磁贴，早上进门时，孩子们会把磁贴贴在符合当天心情的那张脸下面。放学前，老师会把磁贴的分布记在本子上。
body_en: An emotion board hangs by the door of the kindergarten classroom, with five round faces of different expressions drawn on it, arranged in order from laughing to crying. Each child has a magnet printed with a small animal, and when coming in each morning, the children stick their magnets under the face that matches their mood that day. Before school ends, the teacher notes down in a notebook how the magnets are spread across the board.

body_zh: 实验室的压力测试分为三个阶段。第一阶段，受试者安静地坐五分钟，仪器记录基础心率。第二阶段，他们在评委面前做三分钟即兴演讲，第三阶段是十分钟的放松，期间播放轻柔的音乐，研究员观察各项指标如何回落。
body_en: The stress test in the laboratory has three stages. In the first stage, participants sit quietly for five minutes while instruments record their baseline heart rate. In the second stage, they give an impromptu speech lasting three minutes in front of judges, and the third stage is ten minutes of relaxation with soft music playing, during which researchers watch how each measure comes back down.

body_zh: 晚上九点一过，这位退休木匠就关掉电视，到阳台上慢慢踱步一刻钟。踱完步，他用温水泡脚，顺手翻几页旧画报，十点前准时熄灯躺下。家里人说这套睡前的习惯他已经保持了十几年，很少被打乱。
body_en: Once it is past nine in the evening, the retired carpenter switches off the television and paces slowly on the balcony for a quarter of an hour. After pacing, he soaks his feet in warm water, leafs through a few pages of an old picture magazine, and lies down with the lights off before ten without fail. His family members say he has kept this bedtime routine for more than ten years and it is rarely disrupted.

body_zh: 上周五下午，仓库里的一台叉车突然停在通道中间，几名装卸工只好改用手推车搬货。那天傍晚，班长注意到大家说话的声音比平时低了许多，有人坐在箱子上发呆，直到维修工修好叉车，气氛才慢慢轻松起来。
body_en: Last Friday afternoon, a forklift in the warehouse suddenly stopped in the middle of the aisle, and several loaders had to switch to hand carts to move the goods. That evening, the team leader noticed that everyone was speaking much more quietly than usual and some sat on boxes staring blankly, and only after a mechanic fixed the forklift did the mood slowly lighten.

body_zh: 期末考试结束的那天，图书馆的自习室一下子空了大半，留下的几个学生也不再埋头看书，而是靠在椅背上谈论假期的安排。傍晚时分，一名学生把借来的一大摞参考书一次还清，管理员看见他走出大门时脚步轻快了不少。
body_en: On the day the final exams ended, the study room of the library suddenly emptied by more than half, and the few students who stayed were no longer buried in their books but leaned back in their chairs talking about plans for the holiday. Toward evening, one student returned a big pile of borrowed reference books all at once, and the librarian saw him walk out the door with a much lighter step.

body_zh: 在人数不多的团队里，情绪常会在成员之间传递。一个人持续皱眉叹气，周围的同事在一两个小时内也更容易显得沉闷，相反，有人轻松地讲个笑话，屋里的气氛多半会跟着缓和。心理学上把这种现象称为情绪感染。
body_en: In teams with only a few members, moods often pass from one member to another. When one person keeps frowning and sighing, nearby colleagues are also more likely to seem gloomy within an hour or two, and conversely, when someone cheerfully tells a joke, the atmosphere in the room usually eases along with it. Psychology calls this phenomenon emotional contagion.

body_zh: 这家纺织厂的车间实行固定的休息规则，工人每连续工作两个小时，便离开机台休息十分钟，多数人会走到院子里晒晒太阳。车间主任观察到，规则实行以后，下午的操作失误减少了，工人之间的争执也比以前少见。
body_en: The workshop of this textile mill follows a fixed rest rule, under which workers leave their machines for a break of ten minutes after every two hours of continuous work, and most of them walk out into the yard to enjoy the sun. The workshop director has observed that since the rule took effect, operating errors in the afternoon have decreased and disputes among the workers have become less common than before.

body_zh: 按照东区老街的改造方案，整条街长约八百米，原有路面宽九米，改造后拓宽到十四米，两侧各留出三米宽的人行道。沿街将新增路灯46盏，种植银杏120棵，工期预计为五个月。
body_en: According to the renovation plan for the old street in the eastern district, the street is about eight hundred meters long, its original road surface is nine meters wide, and after renovation it will be widened to fourteen meters, with a sidewalk three meters wide on each side. Along the street 46 new streetlights will be added and 120 ginkgo trees planted, and the work is expected to take five months.

body_zh: 园林站的台账显示，这个街道去年建成三处口袋公园，面积分别是600平方米，850平方米和1200平方米，合计2650平方米。园中共栽下灌木约九百株，设置座椅32张，夜间照明全部采用太阳能灯。
body_en: The ledger of the landscaping station shows that the subdistrict completed three pocket parks last year, measuring 600, 850 and 1200 square meters, for a total of 2650 square meters. About nine hundred shrubs were planted in the parks, 32 benches were installed, and all the night lighting uses solar lamps.

body_zh: 改造后的社区小广场呈不规则的五边形，地面铺着浅黄色的透水砖，中央有一棵上了年纪的老槐树，树下围了一圈石凳。广场北侧是一排矮矮的花坛，南侧留出一块空地，每到傍晚，几位老人就在空地上打太极拳。
body_en: The renovated neighborhood square is an irregular pentagon paved with light yellow permeable bricks, and in its center stands an aged pagoda tree, ringed by stone stools beneath it. On the north side of the square is a row of low flower beds, while on the south side an open space is left, where a few elderly people practice tai chi every evening.

body_zh: 街口新建的公交候车亭用浅蓝色钢板做顶棚，边缘微微上翘，整座亭子长约十二米。亭子里有一排不锈钢座椅，背后的玻璃墙上贴着线路图，旁边是一块电子屏，显示下一班车还有几分钟到站。
body_en: The new bus shelter at the street corner has a roof of light blue steel panels with slightly upturned edges, and the whole shelter is about twelve meters long. Inside it is a row of stainless steel seats, a route map is posted on the glass wall behind them, and next to the map is an electronic screen showing how many minutes remain before the next bus arrives.

body_zh: 这条主干道的改造分段推进。头两个月，施工队封闭北半幅，挖开旧路面后更换下面的雨水管道。第三个月转到南半幅，做法与北边相同，最后两周统一铺设沥青并划好标线，道路随即恢复双向通行。
body_en: The renovation of this main road advances section by section. In the first two months, the construction crew closes the northern half, digs up the old surface and then replaces the storm pipes beneath it. In the third month the work moves to the southern half and proceeds the same way as in the north, and in the final two weeks asphalt is laid and lane markings are painted along the whole road, after which traffic resumes in both directions.

body_zh: 社区花园从一块荒地变成现在的样子，前后用了将近一年。起初，设计师到附近楼栋走访住户，收集大家对植物和座椅的想法。方案定稿后，志愿者分批清理碎石和杂草并翻松土壤，随后种下月季和薄荷，花园在第二年春天正式开放。
body_en: It took nearly a year for the community garden to turn from a patch of wasteland into what it is now. At first, the designer visited residents in the nearby buildings to gather their ideas about plants and seating. After the plan was finalized, volunteers cleared gravel and weeds in batches and loosened the soil, then planted Chinese roses and mint, and the garden officially opened in the spring of the following year.

body_zh: 去年夏天的一场暴雨过后，老城区的一个路口积水深达半米，几辆小汽车熄火停在水中。排水部门事后检查发现，路口下方的管道被树根堵住了一大半，工人用三天时间更换了管段，此后同样的雨量再没有造成积水。
body_en: After a rainstorm last summer, water at an intersection in the old town reached half a meter deep, and several cars stalled and stood in the water. A later inspection by the drainage department found that the pipe under the intersection was more than half blocked by tree roots, workers spent three days replacing that section of pipe, and since then the same amount of rain has not caused flooding again.

body_zh: 上个月，河滨街道把一段废弃的铁路改成了步行道，开放的第一个周末就迎来了大批散步的居民。原来的铁轨保留了一部分，嵌在碎石路面中间，不少家长带着孩子沿铁轨数枕木，管理员估计那两天的游客超过了五千人。
body_en: Last month, the riverside subdistrict turned a stretch of disused railway into a walking path, and on its first weekend open it drew large numbers of residents out for a stroll. Part of the original track was kept, set into the middle of the gravel path, many parents walked along the rails with their children counting the sleepers, and the caretaker estimated that visitors over those two days exceeded five thousand.

body_zh: 一般来说，小街区密路网的规划思路是把大地块切分成较小的街坊，让道路像网格一样均匀分布。这样一来，车流被分散到更多条道路上，行人走到公交站的距离也会缩短，沿街的小商铺往往随之增多。
body_en: Generally speaking, the planning idea of small blocks with a dense road network is to divide large plots into smaller blocks, so that roads are spread evenly like a grid. In this way, traffic is dispersed over more roads, the distance pedestrians walk to a bus stop becomes shorter, and small shops along the streets tend to multiply as a result.

body_zh: 城市道路的路面并非完全水平，中间通常比两侧略高，形成一道平缓的弧度，称为路拱。雨水落下后顺着路拱流向路边，再经雨水口进入地下管道，路面因此不容易积水。改造道路时，这个坡度会被重新测定。
body_en: The surface of a city road is not perfectly level, as the middle is usually slightly higher than the two sides, forming a gentle curve called the crown. Rainwater that falls flows along the crown toward the roadside and then into the underground pipes through the drain inlets, so the road surface does not easily collect water. When a road is renovated, this slope is measured again.

body_zh: 这个小区十月份共收集厨余垃圾3200千克，可回收物1150千克，其他垃圾4600千克。与九月份相比，厨余垃圾增加了约两成，其他垃圾减少了300千克，督导员认为这主要得益于新增的两个投放点。
body_en: This residential compound collected 3200 kilograms of kitchen waste in October, along with 1150 kilograms of recyclables and 4600 kilograms of other waste. Compared with September, kitchen waste rose by about twenty percent and other waste fell by 300 kilograms, which the supervisor credited mainly to the two newly added collection points.

body_zh: 本周一上午，水质监测员在河道的三个断面各采集了一份水样。上游断面的溶解氧为每升8毫克，中游为每升7毫克，下游降到每升5毫克，水温均在18摄氏度左右，三个断面的浑浊度都比上月略低。
body_en: On Monday morning this week, a water quality monitor collected one water sample at each of three sections of the river. Dissolved oxygen was 8 milligrams per liter at the upstream section and 7 at the middle section, dropping to 5 downstream, the water temperature at all three was around 18 degrees Celsius, and the turbidity at all three sections was slightly lower than last month.

body_zh: 小区门口的垃圾分类亭是一间带顶棚的小屋，正面并排放着四只颜色不同的垃圾桶，分别是绿色，蓝色，红色和灰色。桶盖上印着简单的图案，亭子侧面装着一个洗手池，夜里顶棚下的灯会一直亮到十点。
body_en: The waste sorting kiosk at the gate of the compound is a small hut with a canopy, and along its front stand four bins of different colors, which are green, blue, red and gray. Simple pictures are printed on the lids, a wash basin is fitted on one side of the kiosk, and at night the light under the canopy stays on until ten.

body_zh: 水库中央漂着一台水质自动监测浮标，外形像一只橙色的大陀螺，直径约一米半。浮标顶部装着一块太阳能板和一根短天线，底部的探头伸到水下半米深处，每隔四个小时测一次水温和酸碱度，数据通过无线信号传回岸上的站房。
body_en: An automatic water quality monitoring buoy floats in the middle of the reservoir, shaped like a big orange spinning top about one and a half meters across. A solar panel and a short antenna are mounted on top, and the probe at the bottom reaches half a meter below the surface, measuring water temperature and acidity every four hours and sending the data by wireless signal back to the station building on shore.

body_zh: 采集水样有一套固定的流程。到达采样点，监测员拿河水把采样瓶涮洗三遍，接下来把瓶子压到水面下约三十厘米处灌满。贴好标签的样品放进冰盒保持低温，当天送回实验室，四十八小时内完成化验。
body_en: Collecting water samples follows a fixed procedure. On reaching the sampling point, the monitor rinses the sample bottle three times with river water, and next pushes the bottle about thirty centimeters below the surface to fill it. The labeled samples go into a cooler to stay cold, are taken back to the laboratory the same day, and are analyzed within 48 hours.

body_zh: 办公楼的节能改造是逐层完成的。工人每到一层，就把旧的日光灯管拆下，换成发光二极管灯，同时在走廊加装感应开关。整栋楼改完后，物业又把空调的夏季温度下限设为二十六度，改造后第一个月的电费比去年同期少了将近三分之一。
body_en: The energy saving retrofit of the office building was done floor by floor. On each floor, the workers took down the old fluorescent tubes, replaced them with light emitting diode lamps, and at the same time installed sensor switches in the corridor. After the whole building was finished, the property management also set the lowest summer temperature for the air conditioning at 26 degrees, and the electricity bill in the first month after the retrofit was nearly one third lower than in the same period last year.

body_zh: 前天清晨，河边收集点的垃圾桶旁堆着十几袋没有分类的垃圾，袋子里既有剩饭剩菜，也有废纸和塑料瓶。督导员当天就在附近几栋楼的楼道里贴出分类示意图，三天后再去查看，同一位置的垃圾已经基本分好了。
body_en: Early in the morning the day before yesterday, more than ten bags of unsorted waste were piled beside the bins at the collection point by the river, holding leftover food as well as waste paper and plastic bottles. That same day the supervisor put up sorting diagrams in the stairwells of several nearby buildings, and when checking again three days later, found that the waste at the same spot had mostly been sorted.

body_zh: 八月中旬，一座小型水库的监测数据显示，水中的藻类在一周内迅速增多，水面局部泛起了绿色。技术人员赶到现场取样，判断这与连日高温和上游冲来的落叶有关，于是打捞了漂浮物，并加大了换水量，半个月后水色恢复了清澈。
body_en: In the middle of August, monitoring data from a small reservoir showed that algae in the water multiplied rapidly within a week, and parts of the surface turned green. Technicians rushed to the site to take samples and judged that this was related to days of high temperatures and fallen leaves washed down from upstream, so they cleared the floating debris and increased the volume of water exchanged, and half a month later the water was clear again.

body_zh: 大块的骨头和贝壳在多数城市并不算作厨余垃圾，而被归入其他垃圾。这类东西质地坚硬，很难被粉碎和发酵，混进厨余垃圾会损坏处理设备。同理，用过的餐巾纸因为难以回收，也被当作其他垃圾处理。
body_en: In most cities, large bones and shells are not counted as kitchen waste but are classed as other waste. Such items are hard and difficult to crush or ferment, and mixing them into kitchen waste can damage the processing equipment. Likewise, used paper napkins are treated as other waste because they are hard to recycle.

body_zh: 许多电器在关机后仍处于待机状态，插头不拔，就会持续消耗少量电能。一台电视机的待机功率通常只有几瓦，但一年累积下来可达二三十度电，所以一些家庭习惯使用带开关的插线板，睡前把整排插座一次断开。
body_en: Many appliances remain on standby after being switched off, and as long as the plug stays in, they keep consuming a small amount of electricity. The standby power of a television is usually only a few watts, but over a year it can add up to twenty or thirty kilowatt hours, so some households make a habit of using power strips with switches and cutting off a whole row of sockets at once before bed.

body_zh: 镇上邮局上周收寄平信312封，挂号信47封，包裹86件。寄往外省的包裹有29件，挂号信从收寄到签收平均用时两天，投递员每天上午和下午各出班一次，整周没有出现退件。
body_en: Last week the town post office accepted 312 ordinary letters, 47 registered letters and 86 parcels. Of the parcels, 29 were sent to other provinces, registered letters took two days on average from acceptance to signed delivery, the carriers went out twice a day, once in the morning and once in the afternoon, and no items were returned all week.

body_zh: 线路维护班这个月的巡检里程是68公里，更换老化线杆11根，紧固松动的线夹230多处。其中，山区路段占了近一半的工作量，巡检员平均每天步行约十五公里，全月通信线路中断的累计时间不到三小时。
body_en: The line maintenance crew covered 68 kilometers on inspection rounds this month, replacing 11 aging poles and tightening more than 230 loose line clamps. Of this, mountain sections made up nearly half of the workload, the inspectors walked about fifteen kilometers a day on average, and the total time the communication lines were down during the month was under three hours.

body_zh: 这座老邮局建于上世纪五十年代，是一栋两层的红砖楼，门口立着一只墨绿色的圆筒邮筒。营业厅里的木头柜台被磨得发亮，窗边放着一台老式磅秤，柜台后面是一整面墙的分拣架，几十个格子下面各贴着一个村名。
body_en: This old post office was built in the 1950s, a red brick building of two floors with a dark green cylindrical mailbox standing at its door. In the service hall the wooden counter has been worn shiny, an old platform scale sits by the window, and behind the counter a whole wall is taken up by sorting racks, with the name of a village posted under each of the dozens of pigeonholes.

body_zh: 投递员用的邮包由深绿色的帆布做成，背带很宽，可以斜挎在肩上。包里缝着三个隔层，前层放平信，中层放报纸，最里层装挂号信和签收单，包盖内侧印着一行褪色的编号。
body_en: The mailbag used by the carrier is made of dark green canvas, with a wide strap so that it can be worn across the shoulder. Three compartments are sewn inside, the front one for ordinary letters, the middle one for newspapers and the innermost one for registered letters and delivery receipts, and a faded serial number is printed on the inside of the flap.

body_zh: 一封平信从投进邮筒到送到收件人手中，大致经过五道环节。邮递员每天傍晚开筒取信，带回邮局盖上邮戳，分拣员按地址把信分进不同的格子，次日一早，信件随邮车运往目的地，再由当地投递员送上门。
body_en: An ordinary letter goes through roughly five stages from being dropped into a mailbox to reaching the hands of the recipient. Every evening a postal worker opens the mailbox to collect the letters and takes them back to the post office to be postmarked, a sorter places the letters into different pigeonholes by address, early the next morning the letters travel by mail van to their destination, and a local carrier then delivers them to the door.

body_zh: 通信线路出现断点时，维修人员先用仪器测出断点的大致位置，沿线找到后爬上线杆，把两端线头剥开重新接牢，再缠紧防水胶带。接好的线路由两端的同事用测试仪试通，信号稳定以后，这次修复才算结束。
body_en: When a break occurs in a communication line, the repair crew first uses an instrument to find the approximate position of the break, locates it along the line and climbs the pole, strips the two wire ends and joins them firmly, then wraps them tightly with waterproof tape. Colleagues at both ends then check the rejoined line with a line tester, and only once the signal is stable is the repair counted as finished.

body_zh: 上周三，一位投递员在老城区送信时，发现一封信上的门牌号在那条街上并不存在。他没有把信退回，而是到附近的小卖部打听了一圈，得知收信人一家早年已搬到隔壁的巷子，当天下午这封信就送到了收信人手里。
body_en: Last Wednesday, while delivering letters in the old town, a postal carrier found that the house number on one letter did not exist on that street. Instead of sending the letter back, he asked around at a small shop nearby and learned that the family of the addressee had moved to the next alley years ago, and that same afternoon the letter reached the hands of the addressee.

body_zh: 元旦前后连降大雪，通往山村的两根线杆被厚雪压断，村里的固定电话中断了整整两天。线路工人分成两组，踩着积雪把新线杆抬上山，第三天中午，通话恢复了，村口杂货店的公用电话紧跟着就响了起来。
body_en: Around New Year heavy snow fell day after day, two poles on the line to a mountain village were broken under the weight of the snow, and the landline phones in the village were cut off for two whole days. The line workers split into two groups and carried new poles up the mountain through the snow, at noon on the third day the phone service was restored, and the public phone at the general store at the village entrance began ringing right after.

body_zh: 邮政编码由六位数字组成，前两位代表省份，第三位代表邮区，第四位代表县市，最后两位指向具体的投递局。分拣员单看编码就能判断信件的大致去向，分拣速度因此提高了不少。
body_en: A postal code is made up of six digits, the first two standing for the province, the third for the postal zone, the fourth for the county or city, and the last two pointing to a specific delivery office. A sorter can tell the general destination of a letter from the code alone, and sorting speed has risen considerably as a result.

body_zh: 收寄时，挂号信会被编上一个专属号码，此后每经过一个环节都登记一次，投递时由收件人签字确认。平信没有这样的登记，一旦遗失很难查找，而挂号信可以凭收据上的号码查询去向。
body_en: When a registered letter is accepted, it is given a unique number, after which it is logged once at every stage, and on delivery the recipient signs to confirm. Ordinary letters have no such logging and are hard to trace once lost, whereas a registered letter can be traced by the number on its receipt.
